question: Under what condition must a gift be given to one who has been previously accomplished and tested for one year?
premises: A gift is marked as something that must be given.
The recipient is one who was previously accomplished.
That recipient must have been tested for one year.
inference: Imparting is warranted only for a previously accomplished person who has passed a one-year test.
uncertainties: The nature of the gift itself is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: What is to be given must go to one who was previously accomplished and has been tested for one year.
